usageNotes: Use this to retrieve time-series performance metrics (CPU, memory, disk, swap, network) for a specific node on a PDM-managed PVE remote. Both `cf` and `timeframe` are required — choose `AVERAGE` for trend analysis and `MAX` to surface peak utilization spikes. The caller must hold the `Resource.Audit` privilege on the remote/node resource path in PDM.

examples.summary: Fetch hourly average CPU and memory stats for a node named 'pve1' on the remote 'hetzner-de'

tips: All numeric metric fields are optional in each data point; gaps occur when the node was unreachable or data was not yet recorded for that RRD slot.
Use `timeframe=decade` only when you need long-term capacity planning; resolution is very coarse and individual spikes are invisible.
The `cpu-max` field represents the number of logical CPU cores, not a utilization percentage — divide `cpu-current` by `cpu-max` to get a 0–1 utilization ratio.
Disk and memory values are in bytes; convert appropriately before displaying to end users.
The `node` path parameter accepts the literal string 'localhost' to refer to the PDM host itself if it is also a PVE node.
